content.title: The Breakfast Food Bobby Flay's Girlfriend Brooke Williamson Makes For Him (And He Goes Wild For)
content.text: It's always a big deal when two celebrities link up romantically. When it comes to celebrity chefs Bobby Flay and Brooke Williamson, who began dating in 2025, fans are particularly interested in the pair's culinary goings-on. As reported by People in April 2026, Flay had a quick answer when someone on Instagram asked him about the best dish Williamson ever made for him. "Brooklyn has a new recipe for yeasted pancakes that will take over our household as the 'house' pancakes," Flay explained, describing the breakfast treat as "So good!" Traditional pancake recipes (like our three-ingredient version) usually include flour, milk, and eggs, but adding yeast to the mix can elevate the dish's flavors and textures.A staple of breads and doughs, yeast is a leavening agent responsible for the fluffy, pillowy textures carb lovers dream about. Along with building a bouncier pancake, the addition of yeast also causes a chemical reaction between flour and sugar that gives your flapjacks a sourdough-adjacent flavor. It's not clear where Williamson derived inspiration for this impressive pancake recipe, but it's worth noting that some racuchy recipes (also known as Polish pancakes) call for yeast instead of baking soda.Read more: We Finally Know Why Giada De Laurentiis Got DivorcedWhat is Brooke Williamson known for (aside from her delicious yeasted pancakes)?Stack of yeast pancakes on plate. - Saprunova Marina/ShutterstockBrooke Williamson is a chef, restaurateur, cookbook author, and winner/contestant on Food Network and Bravo cooking competitions. As for the chef's relationship with Bobby Flay, the two were friendly before they officially began dating (and long before Williamson introduced the yeasted pancakes Flay loves). Prior to their coupling, Flay tapped Williamson to appear on "Bobby's Triple Threat," and Flay explained on Instagram that the decision was spurred by Williamson's skill in the kitchen and her ability to problem-solve on the fly.Both chefs appear to be comfortable in their relationship, and according to Williamson, both are in agreement where major life upheavals are concerned. When Flay announced that he had no plans to marry again, Williamson co-signed the statement. In a dual interview on the "Elvis Duran Show," she said, "We both need to be on the same page [about marriage]. And we are" (via Parade).While neither chef has any desire to update their marital status, their coupling did lead to one big change. As reported by People, the upcoming season of "BBQ Brawl" will feature Williamson as team captain instead of a judge. As Flay explained, "Our rule between us is that we can't judge each other, because how can we judge each other?"For more food and drink goodness, join our newsletter and add us as a preferred search source.
